source_brief: This is Kenji Miyazawa's short story 注文の多い料理店 ("The Restaurant of Many Orders"), first published in 1924, hosted on Aozora Bunko as card1927.html (the author's death year, 1933, is stated on the card's author-data table). Two young hunters, dressed like British soldiers and carrying guns, get lost deep in the mountains without having caught anything. Cold and hungry, they find an elegant Western-style restaurant that advertises itself as welcoming any guest, and they go inside. As they move from room to room, each door displays an increasingly strange instruction -- ostensibly to prepare the guests for a fine meal, but in fact to prepare the two men themselves to be eaten -- and the hunters, still hungry and growing more uneasy at each step, keep obeying the instructions until they finally realize, with real alarm, what kind of restaurant they have walked into.
